name: Kazimierz Lewandowski
bio:
Kazimierz Lewandowski's journey into motorsport security was unconventional, beginning with a background in military intelligence. After a decade of service, he transitioned his skills to the private sector, focusing on risk assessment and security protocols for high-profile events. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, Kazimierz saw an opportunity to combine his expertise with his passion.

At ART Grand Prix Academy, Kazimierz takes a proactive approach to security. He emphasizes preventative measures, meticulously analyzing potential vulnerabilities and implementing robust security systems. He believes in fostering a culture of security awareness within the team, ensuring every member understands their role in maintaining a safe and secure environment. His meticulous nature and dedication to excellence make him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Kazimierz is a man of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with security protocols and potential threats.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his glasses before every meeting.
Speaks fluent German, often muttering security instructions in German during tense situations.
